capabilities: Sync the vault across devices through user-configured S3-compatible or WebDAV storage with end-to-end encryption
Merge concurrent edits line by line, word by word, and resolve conflicts with a resolver
Keep version history and restore files, deleted files, folders or the whole vault to an earlier time
Share folders or property-marked notes with other people through invite links, with edit, read-only, or suggest roles
Publish notes marked publish: true as unencrypted web pages to a separate bucket or WebDAV location
extras: README warns the plugin is young (0.6) and to keep backups; a lost passphrase makes the stored data undecryptable by anyone; published websites are not encrypted; no account, payment, telemetry, or update checks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through storage the user owns, with end-to-end encryption, conflict merging and version history.

requires.name: an S3-compatible bucket or WebDAV server (e.g. Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Amazon S3, MinIO, Nextcloud)
storage access keys or WebDAV credentials
an account with the storage provider
Node.js 22.18+ for the optional command-line tool

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault sync through your own S3-compatible or WebDAV storage, with merging, version history, folder sharing, and optional site publishing.
